wwk.text: Anowon ambushes Sabra and slits her throat, and she glimpses her attacker before losing consciousness.

roe.text: Anowon is accused of murdering Bloodchief Tenihas, and after getting the Dragon's Fire scroll he renounces his expeditionary house and disappears.

Posing as Kejahar, he infiltrates the scholars of the Lighthouse in Sea Gate, seeking the Eye of Ugin, until the militia uncover his vampire nature and the townspeople beat him nearly to death and cast him into the Halimar, though he survives.

He then steals and kills in his hunt from his Akoum camp, agrees to guide Chandra once he learns she also seeks the Eye, and tries to kill her in her sleep when he finds she has a physical map, but Sarkhan Vol knocks him out.

Jace persuades him to lead the way to the Eye, the Brood Lineage enslave him until Sorin Markov and Nissa Revane free him, and when Nissa's actions release the Eldrazi Titans, Anowon flees with the planeswalkers to Affa, where they part ways.

znr.text: Anowon secretly follows an emissary seeking Tarsa in Nimana's market, but Eret seizes him as a spy, and he asks to join the party for a fraction of the earnings in exchange for knowledge.
On the expedition to the Skyclave he finds the walls are also a map and shows the party how to hide from Grakmaw's heat sense by becoming colder.

Tarsa objects to his taking kor poisons, but he throws a kor potion that turns Grakmaw's heads to stone and kills it, and Tarsa then invites him to be their fourth hook, which makes Anowon realize he longs for belonging.
